title: Drill Briefing Checklist (Pre-Drill & Post-Drill)
description: Short structured briefing to run before and after any dp_drills task, adapted from IMCA M273 Appendix B for a single-trainee ship-based simulator context. Keep the pre-drill briefing to 5 minutes; the debrief is where the real learning happens.

pre_drill.item: Confirm the drill type: live simulator, desktop, or touch (mimic-only)
State the failure mode being simulated and why it matters
Confirm current DP configuration and any known limitations
State which actions are real, which are simulated, and which are mimic-only
Confirm no unplanned intervention outside the drill scope
State the expected DP system behaviour and alarms before triggering the fault
Confirm who can stop the drill immediately if anything looks unsafe

post_drill.item: Did the drill proceed as planned?
Did the DP system react as expected? Note any surprises.
Was the TDPO's prediction (made before the fault) correct?
What did not go well, or took longer than expected to recognise?
What would be done differently next time?
Record outcomes in the session log against the relevant dp_drills task ID
